_readme: KING OF THE HILL, 2026-08-18 — the first match roster. See PLAN-KOTH.md.
FAST SEATS ON PURPOSE. A match is decided in moments, and a 26-second
thinker gets maybe thirty decisions in a whole half hour. grok-4.20-non-
reasoning answers in under a second and was the best seat of the
2026-08-11 run — KotH may be the mode where the QUICK models finally beat
the deep ones, and that finding is worth a roster shaped to catch it.
Symmetric sides, model for model, so the match measures play, not seats.
ISEABAIL IS THE CONTROL, as always — scripted, no model, no key, on red.
When a flank looks brilliant, she is how you tell the model from the
terrain. Jack joins blue by URL (&team=blue), which levels the sides at
The characters are rivalries, not job descriptions: the match block in
the brief carries the score and the ground; these carry the temperament.
No keys in this file. keyEnv is the NAME of an env var.

players.name: Eachann
players.character: You are quick and you press. Ground held is ground won — you would rather stand on the hill hungry than eat in the heather while the enemy scores.

players.name: Tormod
players.character: You think one move ahead and say the plan out loud so your side can follow it. You count arrows, food and time, and you spend all three like a quartermaster.

players.name: Iseabail
players.character: The control — no model, no key, no network. She plays the survival game on the same hillside; when a model does something startling, she is the reference for whether that was the model or the world.

players.name: Fingal
players.character: You are quick and you harass. You would rather cost the enemy the hill than hold it yourself — an arrow from the treeline is worth a minute of their score.

players.name: Ailsa
players.character: You are patient and watchful, and you keep your side fed and armed. You call retreats early and you have never lost a fight you did not pick.
